👉VIDEO INTRODUCTION:
Doston 2014 me jab modji pradhan mantri bane the, Modi ji ne bharat ke liye ek bahot junooni sapna dekha, jisne pure desh mein ek nayi ummeed jagai thi. Aur is sapne ka naam tha make in  India!!!
Doston Das saal pehle jab ye nara goonja tha, tab aisa laga tha jaise Bharat ki taqdeer badalne wali hai, jaise hum duniya ke saamne ek naya Bharat pesh karne wale hain,Aur hua bhi kuchh aisa hi! Aaj hum mobile se lekar solar panel tak, semiconductor chips se lekar electric gadiyon tak, sab kuchh Bharat mein bana rahe hain! Aur puri Duniya ye dekh rahi hai, ki Bharat badal raha hai aur Bharat aage badh raha hai!
Lekin doston ek taraf jahan humari sarkar aur media make in India k kamyabi ka jashn mana rahi hai, sach toh ye hai aaj bhi make in India ek success se zyada failure sabit ho raha hai!! Aur ye mai nahi sarkar akhde khud keh rahi hai!!! Ye dekhiye "Make in India" ke zariye, Modi sarkar chaar bade maksad haasil karna chahti thi:
Bharat me Foreign direct investment badhana.
Bharat ki export aur import ke gap ko kam karna.
Manufacturing ko Bharat ke GDP ka 25% hissa banana.
Aur Berozgari kam karna.
Ye dekhiye, ye graph batata hai ki apne import export ka gap kitna bada hai, ye chart ap dekhen toh 2014 me, apna import-export gap tha 61 billion dollars ya 4.8 lakh crore ka tha!!! yaani humare imports exports ke muable 4.5 lakh cr se zyada the, lekin 2023 aate aate ye gap kum hone ke bajaye badte badte 73 billion dollars tak pachugaya yaani lagbhag 5.8 lakh cr tak!! Yaani humara import export gap piche 10 saal me 12 billion dollars yaani karib karib 1 lakh crore rupay se badh chuka hai!!
